# Support plans

Momento Cache offers three support plans: **Basic**, **Production**, and **Enterprise**.
Basic is included. Production and Enterprise add service-level commitments, response targets,
support channels, and plan-specific platform options.

:::note Selecting a plan
The Production and Enterprise prices below preserve the plan's exact pricing terms. Contact your
Momento account team to confirm how the fixed monthly amount and percentage of spend apply, which
charges make up spend, the support coverage, and availability of plan-specific capabilities.
:::

## Service and support

| Plan detail | Basic | Production | Enterprise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Price | Included | $500 / month or 10% of spend | $5000 / month or 15% of spend |
| Minimum commitment | None | 3 months | 1 year |
| Service SLA | Best effort | 99.9% | 99.99% |
| Support response targets | None | P1: 2 hours; P2: 8 hours; P3: 2 business days | P1: 1 hour; P2: 4 hours; P3: 1 business day |
| Support channels | GitHub | Email | Slack and phone |
| Support language | English | English | English |

Contact your Momento account team for severity definitions and support coverage hours.

## Platform options

| Plan detail | Basic | Production | Enterprise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Compliance | GDPR | SOC 2 | HIPAA |
| SSO | Google IdP | Google IdP | Google IdP |
| Team roles | None | Owner, Operator, and Viewer | Custom |
| Deployment | Cloud | Cloud | BYOC and self-hosted |
| Metrics | Console | CloudWatch and Prometheus | Request logs |
| Networking | Public gateway | Public gateway | VPC Peering, Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink |

Each cell reports the option listed for that plan. Confirm whether capabilities are cumulative and
ask your Momento account team for the specific reports, agreements, and scope associated with each
compliance label.
